metadata.name: stage-span-paper-grade-surgery-geometry
metadata.intent: Stage-span paper grade, surgery geometry profile: paper-grade power and span capture of the feature-set surgeries (orientation, shape, translation) at the two columns no earlier paper-grade run covers -- the SEA-AD table and n = 200 at four stages -- for the visibility contrast with the stage-span construction; 500 replicates x 999 permutations.
notes: Stage-span paper grade (change stage-span-paper-grade, 0.17.0): the surgery sibling. construction, span_layers and span_scale are unset (the default feature-set surgery).

Two explicit design points, both on methylation + expression: the SEA-AD MTG table [[11, 10, 28], [9, 10, 12]] at three stages (the baseline, default n_samples 600) and n = 200 at four stages. At n = 200 and n = 80 on two blocks and n = 200 on three blocks the surgeries are the 2026-10-29 design-guidance slice's cells (500 x 999) on the same datasets, so they are not re-run (non-goal).

Modes orientation, shape and translation at e = 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 (the slice's and the pilots' grid). Seeds depend only on the family and the replicate index, so these cells draw the 2026-11-04 stage-span pilot's SEA-AD surgery cells' and the 2026-10-28 design-guidance pilot's four-stage cells' seeds and parameters at replicates 0-99 (p-values not comparable: 199 permutations there).

The anchors are the stage-span profiles' anchor datasets at the same columns (here the SEA-AD anchor is in the primary phase, there in the design phase, so cell ids differ; the reproduction check pairs datasets and p-values, not cell ids).

acceptance: a type_i entry and the advisory anchor_decision (alpha 0.05, k = 2; bound 0.0695 at R = 500). The decision reads this profile's target power and capture descriptively (the visibility contrast); it judges nothing here.

Production measurement named, not defaulted: orientation_estimator net_displacement, min_components 2 and magnitude_kind joint. This is a post-floor config pinned in tests/data/post_floor_config_identity.json. Do not pass --n-jobs; parallelize across shards.
surgery_censoring stays at its default ('error'); the pilot's runs at these columns reported 0 censored surgeries.

submission.timing_basis: scratch leak check (2026-11-04, ing job 933675): 18-28 s per unit at 199 permutations over the five columns; 999 permutations add RRPP time. Final figure from the local smoke (task 7.2) and the timing run on ing (task 9.1).
